backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing PDF upload (chunked), metadata storage, user profiles, and access-controlled operations using MixinStorage and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a single feature (ensuring the frontend actor uses authenticated identity before calling startUpload) to relevant files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, mounting the app at #root and loading the main TSX entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines TanStack Router setup with a shared Layout (Header + Footer) and routes for /, /upload, /dashboard, and /view/:shareId.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright year and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header with logo, Upload/Dashboard links, and an Internet Identity login/logout button that clears the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches the backend actor, using the authenticated identity when available or falling back to anonymous, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity context provider and hook that manages AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, delegation validity checks, and exposes identity and login status to the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations: listing/fetching PDF metadata, chunked upload (start, chunk, finalize), deletion, and title updates.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter and Space Grotesk fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, defines a dark navy + warm amber CSS variable theme, and adds reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page that lists all uploaded PDFs with options to copy share links, inline-edit titles, and delete entries via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Marketing landing page with a hero section and a three-step 'How it works' feature grid, linking to the upload and dashboard pages.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Upload page that handles drag-and-drop or file-picker PDF selection, splits the file into 500 KB chunks, and drives the multi-step upload flow with progress feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ViewerPage.tsx: PDF viewer page that fetches metadata by shareId, downloads the PDF blob via XHR with progress tracking, renders it in an iframe, and provides next-PDF navigation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended typography/border/shadow/animation settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a PDF-sharing website built on the Internet Computer, tracking existing features, known issues (notably upload auth failures), and architectural notes about IC's 2MB message size limit.
